The demons have sent a [[Slayer]] to kill the [[Reaper of the Twin Serpent Mountains]] and the players are required to protect him.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Destroy the Reaper [[Slayer]] before it reaches the mountain top.
* Return to [[Reaper of the Twin Serpent Mountains]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]

==Walkthrough==
As soon as you take the quest the [[Slayer]] will spawn at the bottom of the hill and will move slowly towards the Reaper whom you need to defend. As there is enough room to maneuvre, make sure to do all fighting away from the Reaper. The Slayer itself should pose no threat, however after it will spawn four [[Keeper of Souls|Keepers of Souls]], four [[Terrorweb Dryder|yellow Terrorweb Dryders]] and four [[Terrorweb Dryder (silver)|silver Terrorweb Dryders]]. These groups will slowly advance to the Reaper simultaneously. It is possible to pull the Keepers of Souls forward to buy some time, but due to the close proximity of the groups this may instead cause all 12 dryders to follow. 

In order to survive it is essential to spread the party out and negate the danger from [[AoE]] damage. The key to victory lies in the clustering of the dryders, where they easy to keep in check with AoE damage and skills like [[Panic]]. Due to the sheer number of dryders perfect clusters are hard to force, so deal with the situation as it develops and focus on dryders that are near each other.

It is possible to accept the quest reward after the death of the Slayer, but make sure you take out the groups of Keepers of Souls and Terrorweb Dryders before leaving. Otherwise, they will destroy the Reaper, causing your removal from the Underworld.
